title: Verify repository changes before continuation
summary: Create an explainable, auditable dry-run that inspects the current diff without changing source, release state, or external systems.

evidence.claim: Repository evidence must take precedence over narrative confidence.

acceptanceCriteria: The workflow reaches completed in dry-run mode.
The quality gates run through the critic role and pass.
The audit hash chain verifies after completion.
No source, release, deployment, or remote Git state changes.
